newsitem.title: UK: EMAP says prospects good, UK growth strong.
newsitem.headline: EMAP says prospects good, UK growth strong.

text.p: British publishing group EMAP Plc said on Thursday that prospects for the year ahead were good and business was performing in line with expectations.
In a statement to the annual shareholders' meeting, EMAP said growth in Britain was strong while France remained slow but was improving.
EMAP said it was hedged somewhat against the impact of the strong pound but said the sterling value of its French earnings would be affected.
EMAP said the British advertising market was ahead of last year and France was improving.
The company said it welcomed the recent cut in corporation tax and said it did not expect the changes in dividend taxation policy to have a material effect.
EMAP said a number of new products were in an advanced stage of planning. It gave no further details.
